gui.method: Actual window input and framebuffer; isolated fixture materials, second player, gallery and powered night scene. ENet separately tests command authority.

source.method: Isolated repeated 1800-second run after all builds, renders and exports completed; command wait deadline 15 seconds, observed round trips recorded separately.

soak.limits: Frozen fixture player positions; finite initial factory batch. First competing run failed one 5-second command deadline and remains FAIL. Not a human playtest, external latency certification or 100-player load test.

inventory_native_input.method: Input.parse_input_event mouse down/motion/up, native viewport drag detection, Shift split, outside-panel drop, E pickup, Escape confirmation cancellation, disk reload. Fixture inventory; no direct UI drag/drop callbacks.
